    "suggestion": "Use a set for O(1) membership checks and keep a separate list if order matters, e.g.\n```python\ndef unique_user_ids(events):\n    seen = set()\n    result = []\n    for event in events:\n        uid = event[\"user_id\"]\n        if uid not in seen:\n            seen.add(uid)\n            result.append(uid)\n    return result\n```\nAlternatively, `return list(dict.fromkeys(event[\"user_id\"] for event in events))` preserves order with linear time."
